# advisory lock key is stable and derived from slug

kcdb.repo_lock_key(slug) must be deterministic (same input yields same key) and different slugs yield different keys.

Allow acquiring an advisory lock deterministically before the repository row exists (bootstrap) by deriving the lock key from the slug.
